categories.main_business_segments: Fujian Yongfu Power Engineering Co., Ltd. focuses on zero-carbon power technology, providing integrated power energy solutions including planning consultation, new energy, clean energy, energy storage, smart grid, and digital energy products. The company operates in professional technical services such as power engineering survey and design, EPC engineering contracting, intelligent operation and maintenance, distributed photovoltaic integrated products, and digital energy products. It also invests in new energy power generation projects and has international business operations in Southeast Asia, South Asia, Africa, and the Middle East.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies in offshore wind power, ultra-high voltage transmission, energy storage, digital energy, and distributed photovoltaic systems. It employs EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) contracting with a design-led approach, integrating planning, project development, survey and design, construction, and smart operation. R&D focuses on offshore wind, ultra-high voltage, energy storage, digital energy, and household photovoltaic technologies, supported by multiple research centers and over 270 patents. Production includes system integration, software deployment, and standardized product manufacturing with intelligent operation platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include State Grid Corporation of China, large power generation groups, major private enterprises, and international clients in countries along the Belt and Road Initiative. The company serves government entities, energy companies, industrial enterprises, public buildings, and distributed energy users. Its markets cover domestic China, especially Fujian province and other regions, as well as international markets in Southeast Asia, South Asia, Africa, and the Middle East.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily in China, with significant business in Fujian province and expanding presence in other Chinese provinces such as the Yangtze River Delta and Pearl River Delta. Internationally, the company operates in over a dozen Belt and Road countries including Indonesia, Bangladesh, the Philippines, Singapore, Vietnam, South Korea, Oman, and others in Southeast Asia, South Asia, Africa, and the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the power industry supply chain, providing engineering design, project development, EPC contracting, and operation and maintenance services. It integrates upstream planning and consultation with downstream product manufacturing and smart operation services, positioning itself as a comprehensive service provider in the zero-carbon power system value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening the 'one body, two wings' business layout focusing on integrated power energy solutions and digital energy products. R&D emphasizes offshore wind power, ultra-high voltage transmission, energy storage, digital energy, and distributed photovoltaic technologies. The company invests in innovation platforms such as postdoctoral research stations and multiple R&D centers, aiming to lead in zero-carbon power system technologies and expand international market presence.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through professional technical services including engineering survey and design, EPC contracting, and intelligent operation and maintenance services. Additional revenue streams come from sales of distributed photovoltaic integrated products, digital energy products, and energy sales. The company secures contracts mainly via public and invited bidding, as well as direct commissions, with a focus on long-term project lifecycle services and product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Fujian Yongfu Power Engineering Co., Ltd. is positioned as a leading player in China's power energy industry, recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and a leader in offshore wind power engineering technology. It holds top industry qualifications and has received numerous national and provincial awards. The company competes with other major power engineering and EPC firms, leveraging its comprehensive capabilities, innovation, and international expansion to maintain a first-tier market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.04 billion, a slight increase of 0.3% over the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 36.3 million, a decrease of 33.19%. Total assets reached RMB 4.4 billion, growing 1.95% year-over-year. The company has experienced steady revenue growth with some profit fluctuations, driven by expansion in distributed photovoltaic and digital energy products and international projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering zero-carbon power solutions that are safe, economical, green, efficient, and intelligent. It offers full lifecycle, integrated services from planning to smart operation, supported by advanced technologies and strong R&D capabilities. Its differentiated value lies in comprehensive system solutions covering source, grid, load, storage, charging, and usage, enabling seamless digital and intelligent energy management for diverse customer scenarios, including large-scale and distributed applications.
